end.summary:
Gave examples of regional differences in language, food, dress and festivals.
Identified shared ideas in Lohri and Makar Sankranti, including seasonal change and celebration.
Explained unity in diversity using mixed musical instruments and people sharing meals.
Initially mixed up the diversity example, then clarified that different regions have different clothing suited to climate.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised “unity in diversity” through regional examples, shared festival ideas, and the analogy of instruments making one song. Riya explained several examples clearly and connected Lohri and Makar Sankranti through a common seasonal idea. There was a brief mix-up about the clothing example; it was corrected later by explaining that clothing differs by region and climate (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Riya to make a four-column chart—language, food, dress and festival—with two regional examples and one shared thread.
